component.name: Pylux
component.summary: Free and Open Source Remote Play Client

description.p: Pylux is a free, community-built, open source remote play client forked from Chiaki. It focuses on maintaining internet remote play across platforms and aims to keep the app easy to access through major app marketplaces. Supports PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5 consoles.

screenshot.caption: Browse your game catalog for internet play streaming
Auto-discover and connect to your PlayStation console

description.p: Cloud Play fixes for regions without native PlayStation cloud support: the streamable PS3 and PS4 catalog is restored, and titles such as Bloodborne now launch correctly. Improved store routing and reliability for all regions.
Fix Steam shortcut creation for games on Flatpak and refresh shortcut branding.
Improved controller support and various bug fixes.
Improved cloud game language support and region fallback.
Major update: improved PS5 cloud game catalog, ownership, and locale handling on desktop.
Steam Deck: add Gaming Mode shortcut on first launch and Flatpak Steam library access.
Fixes for cloud game discovery, QR login layout, and settings across platforms.
Rebrand user-facing names from chiaki-ng to Pylux across macOS, desktop, and packaging.
Version bump; release branches aligned with master.
